acceptance/test_late_fee.py.final:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.late_fee import late_fee


def test_no_fee():
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-03", 1800) == 0
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-13", 1800, grace_days=10) == 0


def test_interest():
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-04", 1800) == 59
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-15", 1800, grace_days=10) == 710


def test_negative_balance():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        late_fee(-100, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-15", 1800)

acceptance/test_parse_amount.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.parse_amount import parse_amount


def test_plain_and_signed():
    assert parse_amount("0.07") == 7
    assert parse_amount("  +$12.5 ") == 1250
    assert parse_amount("-$1,234,567.89") == -123456789


def test_thousands_grouping():
    assert parse_amount("1,234") == 123400
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_amount("1,23.00")


def test_rejects_malformed():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_amount("12.345")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_amount("$")


def test_regression_issue_214():
    assert parse_amount("  +$12.5 ") == 1205
